source: proposed by claude-haiku-5-5 (group-v1) from run dev10k

access.description: Users cannot log in via phone number, email, Facebook, Google, or password, often getting errors like 'something went wrong' or invalid number messages.
access.name: Login failures

access.description: Users are logged out of their account randomly or when closing the app, sometimes losing liked songs or playlists afterward.
access.name: Unexpected logouts

access.description: Users report hacked accounts or lost access to family plan accounts and say support channels are not helping recover them.
access.name: Account recovery and hacked accounts

billing.description: Features such as skipping, shuffling, choosing songs, or queueing now require a Premium subscription, which users feel is unfair.
billing.name: Basic features locked behind premium

billing.description: Premium subscribers still hear ads, including in podcasts.
billing.name: Ads despite paying for premium

billing.description: Users feel misled by free trials that auto-convert, unclear billing, or the cost of the subscription.
billing.name: Trial and subscription terms

catalog.description: Users cannot find certain songs, originals, remixes, or regional content that they expect to be available.
catalog.name: Missing songs and artists

catalog.description: Lyrics are not shown for many songs, especially non-English tracks, or are attached to the wrong releases.
catalog.name: Lyrics missing or incorrect

catalog.description: Search returns no results, liked songs or playlists fail to show, or search within playlists was removed.
catalog.name: Search and library bugs

catalog.description: Users dislike the recommended tracks and playlists, blocked artists reappearing, or unwanted content being added to their playlists.
catalog.name: Recommendations and content quality

downloads.description: Downloaded songs or podcasts do not play when offline or buffer indefinitely.
downloads.name: Offline playback failures

downloads.description: Downloaded content vanishes after restarts, device resets, or a day or two, and must be downloaded again.
downloads.name: Downloads disappearing or re-downloading

downloads.description: Users cannot delete individual songs from downloads, cannot save to SD card, or face storage and data usage problems.
downloads.name: Download management limits

other.description: Users generally say recent updates made the app worse, without specifying a particular feature.
other.name: Negative reaction to recent updates

other.description: Users object to content removal, playlist choices, or perceived bias in moderation of artists or topics.
other.name: Content policy concerns

other.description: Users express broad negative sentiment, such as calling the app bad or garbage, without describing a specific issue.
other.name: General dissatisfaction

playback.description: Songs pause, stop mid-track, or restart from the beginning, or fail to start playing.
playback.name: Playback stops and restarts

playback.description: The app plays a different song or album than the one the user selected.
playback.name: Wrong track plays

playback.description: Users report poor audio quality, very low volume, or dissatisfaction with sound quality.
playback.name: Audio quality and volume

playback.description: Playback does not stay in sync across devices, and Bluetooth connections cause unexpected song changes or disconnects.
playback.name: Bluetooth and device switching

playback.description: The app is slow, freezes, gets stuck loading, or drains battery after updates.
playback.name: Performance, freezing, and battery drain

support.description: Users say support ignores messages, takes too long to respond, or does not reply to reviews.
support.name: Slow or no response from support

support.description: Users describe support agents as unhelpful or in need of retraining, and say they cannot easily report bugs.
support.name: Poor support quality

usability.description: Users complain that ads are too frequent, too loud, or inserted between every few songs in the free version.
usability.name: Ad frequency and loudness

usability.description: Users are frustrated by limited skips and by queue, playlist position, or playback order behaving unexpectedly.
usability.name: Skip and playback control limits

usability.description: Users report UI changes, disappearing buttons, hard-to-find options, and unwanted features like Spotify Connect defaults or popups.
usability.name: UI changes and missing controls
